director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
mujhe nahi pata
Aaj hum scale se lambai naapenge, metre aur centimetre mein. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi, aap batao

Chalo, main batati hoon. Cricket bat ka handle bhi scale se naapte hain. Scale par 0 se 1, 1 se 2, har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Pencil 0 se 7 tak rakhi hai: 7 khaane, toh 7 centimetre. Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

director.text: 6 cm hai na

Bilkul sahi: 3 se 9 tak 1-1 centimetre ke 6 khaane hain, yaani 9 − 3 = 6 centimetre. Scale ka pehla khaana 0 aur 1 ke beech hota hai. Jo cheez 1 se shuru hoti hai, uske neeche woh pehla khaana aata hi nahi. Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

director.text: saat centimetre

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki pehla khaana patte ke neeche nahi aata. Golu ka scale toot gaya, ab woh 4 se shuru hota hai. Uske khaane bhi 1-1 centimetre ke hain: cheez jahan se shuru ho, wahin se khaane gino. Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: twelve

Sahi jawab. 4 se aage 8 khaane chalo toh 12 aata hai: 4 + 8 = 12. Ab ek sawaal milkar, aaram se hal karte hain. Golu ka toota scale 4 ke nishaan se shuru hota hai. Uspar ek tehni 5 ke nishaan se 12 ke nishaan tak rakhi hai. Tehni ki lambai nikaalni hai. Tehni ki lambai ke liye 12 mein se kaunsa nishaan ghataoge?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, aaram se hal karte hain.

director.text: Nahi, yeh nahi hai. Tehni 5 se shuru hoti hai, scale ke 4 se nahi. Isliye 12 mein se 5 ghatayenge. Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: sawaal kya hai?
Toote scale par 5 se 12 tak rakhi tehni kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 7 centimetre lambi

Bilkul sahi: 12 − 5 = 7 khaane tehni ke neeche hain, aur har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Toh poora jawab: tehni 7 centimetre lambi hai. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?

director.text: four centimetres

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki rubber ke neeche 5 se 6, 6 se 7, 7 se 8 aur 8 se 9: 4 khaane, toh 4 centimetre. Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?
director.card: Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?

director.text: laal lamba hai

Sahi jawab. Neela 3 se chalkar 9 tak jaata hai, toh bas 6 centimetre; laal poore 7, isliye laal lamba. Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?

director.text: 15 cm

15 cm sahi nahi hai. Ise doosri tarah samajhte hain. Nishaan nahi, khaane gino. 2 se 5 tak teen khaane hain: 2 se 3, 3 se 4, aur 4 se 5. Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

Ungli 6 wale nishaan par rakho, aur 10 tak ek-ek khaana kood kar jao. Har kood ek centimetre hai. Toote scale par 6 se 10 tak rakhi chabi kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

Yahan wahi toota scale hai, aur chabi ke sire se ginti shuru karke dikhayi hai: 6 se 7 tak pehla khaana. Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki ginti grip ke shuru wale 6 se hoti hai, toh 15 − 6 = 9 khaane, yaani 9 centimetre. Chhoti cheezein centimetre mein naapte hain. Ab dekhenge ki lambi cheezon ke liye metre kya hai, aur ek metre mein kitne centimetre. Ab tak samajh aaya?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, yeh naap le lene ke baad. Ab yeh kaam poora karte hain. Yeh ek metre ki lakdi hai. Ispar 0 se 100 tak centimetre likhe hain: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100. Toh 1 metre mein 100 centimetre hote hain. Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

70 cm sahi nahi hai. 70 toh bat ki apni lambai hai; poocha yeh hai ki bat ke upar se metre ke aakhri nishaan tak kitna bacha. 70 ke nishaan tak aane wala bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

Bilkul sahi. Metre 100 centimetre ka hai aur bat 70 tak aata hai, toh 100 − 70 = 30 centimetre bacha. Cricket mein kya kuch aisa hai jise tum naap sakte ho?

Wah, chauka! Yeh batane ke liye shukriya. Theek hai, ab phir se apne kaam par lagte hain. Yeh lamba feeta hai, jis par sirf 10-10 centimetre ke nishaan hain. Jahan metre ka number likha hai, wahan poora metre hota hai; do numberon ke beech das chhote khaane. Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Is feete ke khaane scale jaise 1-1 centimetre ke nahi hain; yahan ek metre ke poore 100 centimetre bas das khaanon mein bante hain. Feete par 0 se is nishaan tak wala parda kitne metre aur kitne centimetre ka hai?

Bilkul sahi, kyunki parda 1 metre wale nishaan se 4 chhote khaane aage hai, har ek 10 centimetre, toh 1 metre 40 centimetre. 1 metre 5 centimetre ka matlab: ek poora metre, yaani 100 centimetre, aur 5 centimetre aur. Sahi jawab. 2 metre = 200 centimetre, aur 200 + 8 = 208 centimetre. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge. Ek rassi 3 metre lambi hai. Usmein se 40 centimetre kaat diya. Kitni rassi bachi, metre aur centimetre mein? 40 centimetre ghatane se pehle 3 metre ka kya karoge?
